name: Civilian Complaint Review Board: Allegations Against Police Officers
description:
This dataset contains records from New York City's Civilian Complaint Review Board (CCRB) documenting allegations of misconduct made against police officers. Each row represents a single allegation tied to a complaint, with 5,000 sampled records across 18 columns. The data includes a snapshot date, complaint and allegation identifiers, and officer details such as rank, command assignment, and days on the force at the time of the incident. It also captures the type of alleged misconduct (abuse of authority, force, discourtesy, offensive language, or untruthful statement) and a more specific allegation description.

Victim information is included where available, covering age range, gender, and race or ethnicity, though these fields have notable missing values. The dataset also records how each allegation was handled, including the investigator's recommendation, the CCRB disposition, and the NYPD disposition, allowing comparison between review board findings and police department outcomes.

This data could support analyses of complaint patterns by allegation type, officer rank
